description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachmentAPI class, which is a RESTful API endpoint for managing employee attachments within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting employee attachment records, utilizing various service classes, request validation, and data modeling. The class incorporates Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for API documentation and handles attachment data encoded as base64, along with metadata such as descriptions and attachment details.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for managing employee attachments in the OrangeHRM system, including retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion. Implements CRUD operations with validation, data modeling, and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific employee attachment based on employee number, screen, and attachment ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all attachments for a specific employee on a given screen.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Uploads a new attachment for an employee on a specified screen, including metadata such as description.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee attachment, allowing modifications to description and/or attachment file.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple employee attachments based on provided IDs.
